_comment_secret: secret_path is generated on first start and saved here. It IS the credential: the public URL is https://<domain>/<secret_path>. Rotate = change it, restart, update the URL in Hoplite.
_comment_api_key: Optional. When set, mcp-proxy additionally requires an X-API-Key header — only useful if your MCP client can send custom headers.
_comment_paths: Leave blank to auto-resolve from the global npm tree (APPDATA/npm/node_modules).
_comment_ngrok: config_path points at the agent config you downloaded from dashboard.ngrok.com; bridge.py reads ONLY authtoken and domain out of it (any config version) and never hands the file to ngrok. endpoint_name is kept for reference. Clear config_path to use domain+authtoken below, or clear everything for a random ngrok URL.
_comment_dc: Merged into ~/.claude-server-commander/config.json (desktop-commander's real, SHARED config), preserving clientId/usageStats/limits. allowedDirectories gates FILE operations only — terminal commands still see the whole disk. Empty allowedDirectories = entire filesystem, so bridge.py refuses to start.

desktop_commander._comment_blocked: Add blockedCommands here to impose a blocklist on this bridge. Omitted by default so the shared config of your other MCP clients is not changed. The list below is desktop-commander's own factory default — copy it in if you want it.
